detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for Python packages that spawn subprocesses or execute code from obfuscated strings, especially in utility functions. Flag packages that collect and exfiltrate host data or poll remote servers for executable payloads. Use static analysis to detect XOR/hex/Base64 decryption routines and dynamic analysis to catch delayed or multi-stage execution. Correlate presence of hidden modules and suspicious function names with behavioral indicators for high-confidence detection.
